# Memory

## Data Classification

All stored data is classified as **INTERNAL**. Do not persist CONFIDENTIAL or RESTRICTED data in agent memory.

## Retention Policy

- Retention period: 30 days
- Auto-purge: enabled
- Audit trail: retained for 90 days after memory purge

## Stored Context

### Q3 Planning Notes
The growth team is focused on self-serve onboarding. Key metric: time-to-first-value under 5 minutes.

### Vendor Contacts
Approved vendor list is maintained in SharePoint. Do not store vendor PII in memory.
